tei:div.tei:p: "$ (327)༄༅// chos drug rdo rje'i gzhung bzhugs so//

(328)༄༅// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje'i lus la rdo rje'i rten 'brel bsgrigs// rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje'i lus bug nas// rdo rje gsum brnyes rdo rje'i brtul zhugs can// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba rdo rje'i theg /spang bya lam du byed pa khyad 'phags lam// rten 'brel lus la sgrig pa zab pa'i gnad// myur skyobs bde ba'i lam mchog 'di bkod bya// gang zhig dngos po'i gnas lugs lus dang sems// ji bzhin mngon du byed pa zab mo'i lam// de don mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mchog /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum 'dir thams cad 'dus// rtsa rlung thig le skyon med rdo rje'i lus// gnad du snun par byed pa gtum mo'i lam// sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi rnal 'byor gsum// rim pa gsum la nges par 'bad par bya'o// skyon med lus las yon tan 'byung ba'i phyir// lus kyis lus la gnad du snun pa'i phyir// lus kyi skyon rnams lus kyis dag byed pas// lus kyi bya ba 'khrul 'khor (329)'bad par bya// bcu phrag lnga dang drug gis lhag pa yis// 'khrul 'khor rnams ni nyi ma re re bzhin// dus tshod gsum la re re ma chag par// lha dang stong ra'i sbyor ba ldan pas bya// lus ni chos bdun ldan pas gnas byas la// lha dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams byas nas// rngub dang dgang dang 'bud pa'i sbyor ba yis// bum pa can gyi rlung ni sbyang bar bya// lus dang rtsa yi stong ra gnyis ldan pas// dbu ma chos bzhi ldan pa bsgoms byas la// dhū ti'i mar snar rig pa btsud par bya// rtsa lam sbyangs pas rtsa yi zug rngu med// rlung rnams 'du zhing rtsa yi mdud pa dral// khams rnams g.yos pas srid pa gsum po 'jig /yon tan kun 'byung gsang ba'i lam mchog ste// srog gis lus phug zla ba nam mkhar brtan// sum cu'i zhag gis rlung re gnas su zhi// dbu ma dag pas rlung rnams 'dod don 'byin// de don bla ma dam pa las shes shing*// mthong ba brgyud las rtogs 'gyur gzhan du min// rlung sems dbang du sdud cing rtsa mdud (330)'jig

/dwangs ma g.yo bar byed pa lus kyi gnad// me thabs drug chings bde drod rang 'bar te// bcu phrag gsum na lus kyis mngon gsum mo// drag po gsum dang gcud dang 'jam pa gsum// gsum gsum dgu yis 'bung pa dgu phrugs te// ro stod khengs dang rlung gi nad rnams sel// 'bud pa 'byongs pas rdub pa las su rung*// 'jam la ring bas phyi nas nang du drang*// khengs par bzung la gang ba'i dus na gzhil// mi thub dus na bcag cing sprugs par bya// drag pos 'bud la bar mtshams med par bsgom// rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la brgya dang ni// bcu phrag gnyis dang gsum gyis lhag pa'i rtsa// gdugs kyi rnam pa me yi rang bzhin can// gsal bar sgom pa rtsa yi rnal 'byor ro// rtsa gsum 'jom par a thung rgod ma kha// shad kyi rnam pa sor mo dag gi tshad// rlung gis gtsubs pas me yi rang bzhin 'gyur// rtse gcig bsgoms pas phra ba'i rlung nyid 'gog /sor mo bzhi snyoms 'khor lo rab bcings te// thur sel bskum pas gtum mo'i me chen 'bar// thur du 'gro ba g.yo med brtan par bcing*// rlung gi yon tan ma lus 'di las byung*// sbo 'dril gzer zug 'khrul 'khor drug gis bshig /ngag 'dren gnad kyis 'og rlung steng du 'don// gzhang srin za ba drod kyi sbyor bas bsal// srin lam bsdams na 'khrul 'khor dag gis bsal/ tsha zug la sogs sum cu'i zhag na zhi// ma zos bkres med zos na thams cad 'ju// rlung mkhris ban kan 'dus pa'i nad rnams sel// gtum mo'i me 'bar zla ba zas su 'dzin// a shad srog thur gnyis kyis gtsubs pa las// sor mo bzhi dang bzhi yi bar du 'bar// sku bsrings nas ni snying kha mgrin pa'i bar// gtum (331)mo 'bar nas grang ba'i reg bya 'joms// me yi drod kyis sum cu rtsa gsum khams// dngas ma kun rdar rtse la 'dus pa yis// 'khor lo bzhi po rim pas gang pa las// dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes dran par bya// mthar ni nyi ma zla bas non pa las// mgo zhabs med par bde bas gang byas la// 'bros 'ded la sogs nyams dang bstun la bya// 'khor lo gnyis na thig le'i 'bar 'dzag bsgom// srin po'i gnad dang drang tshugs gsum po sogs// bzung zlog la sogs nyams myong dus dang bstun// rtsa kha sdom dang glod pa la sogs pa// dus tshod ma shes log pa'i lam du 'gyur// steng du 'then cing 'og tu drag por gcud// steng 'og rlung gnyis drag por kha sbyar la// drod dang bde ba stobs ldan rab tu 'bar// ma zhu skran sogs grang ba'i nad rnams 'joms// des kyang bgos chung gtsubs shing me'i 'khor lo// sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khor lo lnga brtsegs dang*// rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dag gi mthar// bsad pa gsum gyi mthar ni dgram dang dbab// gsum tshan gsum gyi me thab dgu skor yin// mgo bo'i 'khrul 'khor lnga dang lag pa'i drug

/rkang pa'i bzhi ste rjes kyi 'khrul 'khor gsum// sbyor ba lnga dang dngos gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gcig /rjes kyi gsum po bsdoms pas dgu skor yin// phyi nang med pa me phung bzhin du 'gyur// me stobs chung na thig le zhal sbyor bya// longs spyod rba rlabs sbom po'i stobs kyis mnan// g.yo ba med 'gyur mi rtog 'od gsal 'char// 'phar sprugs bde ba glum spang khol ba bzhin// gnad kyi gegs sel bla ma'i zhal las shes// brkyang bskum gar gyis thur sel dbang du bya// de la goms nas drang tshugs rnam gsum gyis// (332)rgya mtsho'i stobs kyis sbyor ba steng du drangs// rgya mtsho dgang zhing gcu ba'ang man ngag yin// yi dwags 'dug stangs gsang ba'i lus gnad la// lag pa'i phyag rgya aṃ gu li nyid ni// tshims par mnyes pas gtum mo'i me 'bar bas// rims gyis dbab zlog drang zhing gnas su bskyal// yid 'phrog phyag rgya mdun bsam 'du shes nyid// gsum dang ldan pas mkha' gsang byin gyi rlabs// srub skyong dmigs pas dbab cing bzung bar bya// tshims par gyur nas rang gi gnas su bskyal// pad+ma can sogs bu mo rnam pa drug /rab 'bring tha ma re re'ang gsum gsum ste// brtag dang dgug dang sba zhing dbang byas te// khrims bcu nor sogs dbang gis smin par bya// dben pa'i gnas su bcud ldan bza' btung gis// lus khams rgyas par bya zhing rnal 'byor bsgom// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i// 'dod yon lnga la rim gyis brid cing bslab// sngon 'gro khams la rang dbang ma thob na// dngos gzhi'i dus su rjes chags dbang gyur pas// mda' 'phang bzhin tu byang sems gnas nas 'pho// khu ba nyams pa mnar med dmyal ba'i rgyu// gsum dang ldan pas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab// rol rtsed byas pas gsang ba'i rtsa kha bye// snyom par zhugs la rus sbal 'gros bzhin bya// goms pa chung bas g.yo ba nyid nas bzung*// goms par gyur na dga' bzhi rdzogs par dbab// zab mo'i sbyor bas 'pho med brtan par bcangs// rnam par mi rtog zla ba nam mkhar 'gro// zlog dang dgrams pas bde ba rgyas par byed// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ngag gi drag rlung dang*// sems kyi dmigs pa gnad kyi gdams pa rnams// bla ma dam pa'i zhal las rtogs par gyis// gzhan du byis pa bslu (333)ba mtshangs ston bzhin// bcu gnyis ldan pa'i lus gnad kyis gnas pas// nyi zla g.yo med nam mkha'i dbyings su bcings// 'jam rlung kha sbyor 'bud rngub dgang ba gsum// yi ge gsum dmigs gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag

/'grangs ches ltogs ches mi sgom me chu spang*// rkang rjen drag shul lus po mnye ba dang*// lan tshwa ches dang rga dang g.yer ma dang*// sgog btsong grib zas skyi chags gos sogs spang*// bcud chen zas dang til mar byug pa dang*// kha zas za tshe rlung ro bus la za// 'gyel bub med par rtag par lus po bsrang*// rtsa rlung mi nyams zas spyod brten par bya// phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud rtsi lnga sogs kyi// ro bcud sbyor bas lus kyi stobs rgyas nas// snyigs ma rnams sbyangs rdo rje'i sku 'grub phyir// dwangs ma'i ro bcud kyi ni sbyor bas spel// stong phrag bdun cu gnyis sogs rtsa rnams ni// phal cher skam dang 'byar dang zhar bas na// de dag rlung sogs rtsa yi zug rnams 'byung*// lus sbyong 'khrul 'khor 'bad pas zug las grol// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya las kyi rlung*// rang rang gnas su sbyor ba ma snyoms pas// log dang rengs dang byer dang 'thas pa dang*// 'thums pas rlung gi nad rnams thams cad skyed// rang gnas bzung dang gzhil dang sdud pa dang*// dbab dang gseng ba'i 'khrul 'khor rlung sbyor dang*// dmigs pa sgom dang rten 'brel zab mo yis// rlung gi nad las rnal 'byor rgyal bar bya// sum cu rtsa gnyis gza' skar snyigs ma'i tshogs// bsgoms pas dwangs snyigs phyed cing g.yo ba las// dngos dang rmi lam la sogs 'dzag pa la// 'khrul 'khor rlung sbyor rten 'brel (334)zab mos bcing*// rtsa rlung thig le gnad kyis sgom pa'i nyams// 'phel 'grib la sogs nyams snang sna tshogs pa// gang shar nang gi rten 'brel nyid yin zhing*// 'bor len gnad kyi gdams pas lam du bya// ma rig ba dang nyon mongs las dbang dang*// 'byung bzhi cha ma snyoms pa las byung ba'i// rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad la sogs// phyi nang nad rigs bye brag bsam mi khyab// grogs su 'khyer dang ro snyoms dmigs pa dang*// 'khrul 'khor dbyug pa rin chen sbyor ba sogs// nad rigs bcos dgos so sor ma 'dzol bar// nyams kyi dpags la 'du ba 'khrugs pa bsal// gegs skyon bsal zhing rtse gcig bsgom pa las// sdug bsngal dus dang 'dod chags 'bar ba'i dus// gtum mo yon tan dus dang rnam pa gsum// drod dang bde ba rnam par mi rtog pas// rlung lnga zin dang las rang dbang du 'gyur// rtsa 'dzin nyams dang bha ga rtsa nyams gsum// zin dang stobs 'phel cha snyoms rlung nyams gsum// bdud rtsi cha snyoms stobs 'phel rgyas pa gsum// 'du ba gsum sogs gnas skabs lam gyi rtags// gsang gnas phyed du gang zhing brtan pa las// stong dang brgyad brgya'i las rlan dbu mar thim// mthong ba'i lam ste stong dang brgyad brgya'i bar// bcu gnyis thim pas sgom pa'i lam gyis ni// bcu gcig sa ni yongs su bgrod pa'o// thog ma'i sa la dbu ma'i mdud pa re// bar du sa res gsum gsum sum cu grol// dbu ma'i thog ma'i mdud pa grol ba las// ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes// ro rkyang rtsa dag rtsol ba srog gi rlung*// dbu mar thim pas longs sprul sku gsum brnyes// yab yum zhal sbyor mtshan dpes brgyan pa dang*// stobs bcu mi 'jigs (335)so sor rig pa bzhi// mngon shes drug dang ma 'dres bco brgyad chos// phrin las bzhi yis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes tshe 'dir mngon du byed pa gtum mo'i bde drod rtsol med du skye ba'i gdams pa rdzogs so/// rang bzhin dag pa gdong nas 'od gsal zhing*/

rgyu rkyen gnyis bral lhun grub 'dus ma byas// yod med cir yang ma nges spros pas dben// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// dben pa'i gnas su 'du 'dzi kun spangs la// tsha zer mi bsten bcud can zas dag brten// bla ma'i mos gus gsol 'debs gnad nas skul// rlung drag gcud cing spros med don la bsgom// kha bas dwangs snyigs legs par phyed sogs dus// mi'i seng ge'i nyal thabs cog pu la// lha dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon song nas// hūm̐ gi spro bsdus pad+ma'i skabs bzhin bsgom// mig gnyis sor bzhag dmigs pa yang yang bsten// zhag lnga'i dus las mi 'da' 'dod pa 'grub// de la brten nas rim gyis je cher 'phel// gcig la mi brtan sbyor ba spo mi bya// skya rengs shar nas nyi ma bcu snyed bar// seng ge'i stabs sogs gang bde'i ngang gnas pas// srog rlung gcud cing srog rtsol gnyis kyi dbus// 'dam skyes steng du hūm̐ yig gsal bar bsam// gnad bzhi ldan pas gnyug ma'i ngang du gnyid// skabs su 'dun pa dran pa'i lcag gis bskul// snang mched thob thim lta thabs ngo sprod bya// don ma 'grub na dbugs dang mdzod spur gcud// gnyid mthug gyur pa srod kyi dus dag tu// snying gi chu skyes 'dab ma bzhi pa la// a nu ta ra hūm̐ yig lnga rims bzhin// shes pa gtad la gnad kyi man ngag bsten// tshes gcig nas ni gnyis la gnyid gcig la// gsum (336)nas bzung nas 'dod don ma 'grub bar// a nu la sogs gnad kyi man ngag gis// 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya// grib la 'dzem zhing bcud can kha zas bsten// dben ba'i gnas su legs par mtshams bcad nas// rlung bzung mi rtogs ngang la ma yengs bsgom// bla ma'i mos gus gsol 'debs gnad du che// kun dha mi nyams dam tshig 'di drug bsrung*// chos nyid dri mas dben zhing 'od gsal ste// rang gsal ye gsal kha gting med par gsal// gsal zhing dwangs pas rkyen gyi dbang bzhin 'char// spang rtogs rim bzhin lam gyi 'od gsal te// brgyal dang snyoms 'jug shi dang gnyid log dang*// ting 'dzin dbu mar rlung tshud gnas skabs drug

/ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa 'bras bu'o// nyams kyi 'od gsal mngon par shes pa'i rgyu// srab dang 'thug pas rim bzhin bar do dang*// 'chi ba'i dus la chos sku mngon du byed// nyin mtshan med sgom 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku// 'od gsal gti mug lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa rdzogs so/// /gang gi blo gros nyin mor byed pa'i mthus// gnyis snang mun pa'i smag rum legs bsal nas// gnas lugs ma nor gsal bar ston mdzad pa'i// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// dngos po kun grub sna tshogs ji snyed kun// ji ltar sems kyis bzung zhing der snang phyir// snang ba gzhan du der ni ma skyes te// ma skyes pa la gnas dang 'gag pa med// phyogs kyi cha med dngos po'i rdzas mi srid// cha shas yod na rdzas kyi chung mtha' min// chung mtha' yod na cha shas ji ltar rung*// gcig ma grub phyir du ma ga la yod// ji ltar snang ba rgyu las skyes pa na// thog ma'i rgyu de gang las skye bar 'gyur// de la rgyu yod thog mar mi rung la// rgyu med pas na rgyu las ji (337)ltar skyes// snga ma 'gag pa med phyir skye ba med// phyi ma da ltar med phyir gang las skye// da ltar ba la rgyu 'bras gnyis mi srid// de phyir rgyu las med 'bras rkyen la mtshungs// rgyu nyams pa las 'bras bu mi skye ste// sa bon rul ba'i myu gu ji bzhin no// rgyu mnyam sa la 'bras bu mi srid de// sa bon rang sar gnas pa'i 'bras mi srid// 'bras bu grangs mnyam de yaṃ rgyu yod na// rgyu gcig las skyes 'bras bur ga la 'gyur// 'bras bu re la rgyu re med pa na// rgyu las skyes pa'i 'bras bur ga la 'gyur// rang las rang ma skyes te rang las ni// tha dad pas ni rang las skye ba min// gzhan las rang ni skye ba gang la srid// rgyu la ji ltar rkyen las shes par bya// rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pas 'bras bu skyed byed na// rgyu yang rkyen de byed pa'ang rkyen yin phyir// de dag byar med 'dus ma byas su 'gyur// rgyu rtag pa las 'bras bu skyed mi nus// mi rtag pa ni med phyir skye mi nus// nus pa mthun na rgyu rkyen gnyis ma yin// nus pa mi mthun gcig gis gcig 'joms pas// rgyu rkyen gnyis 'dzom 'bras bu skyed pa med// rang bzhin gcig nas 'bras bu mang po min// tha dad pas na rgyu gcig las skyes min// stong pa yin na med phyir 'bras mi skye// stong min snang zhing bden na'ang 'bras mi skye// bskyed bya skyed byed gcig na rgyu 'bras min// rigs ma mthun na rgyu 'bras 'chol bar 'gyur// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar dus mnyam las/

bskyed bya skyed byed rgyu rkyen 'bras bu med// rgyu la 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dag yod na// yon tan 'bras bu gsar du skyed ci dgos// med na rkyen gyis 'bad pa don med do// dbyibs dang kha dog dri ro nus pa sogs// lhan cig grub phyir so sor byed po med// byed po med na 'dus ma byas su 'gyur// byed po yod na rgyu la rkyen dag gis// 'di yis 'di byas ji ltar shes par 'gyur// rgyu ma 'gags par 'bras bu mi 'byung la// 'bras bu smin tshe rgyu (338)med 'phrel pa med// snga ma'i dngos tshogs phyi ma skyes cho 'gag /ring thung sbom phra dus gcig 'brel pa med// rtse mo ma skyes rtsa ba ji ltar rung*// rtsa ba med pa'i rtse mo ji lta bu// rtsa ba rtse mo thog mar gang zhig skyes// gang skyes rtsa ba rtse mo gnyis ka min// de gnyis mnyam du byung ba'ang ma yin no// dus dang gnas dang ngo bo tha dad nas// tha dad phyir na gcig pa'i 'brel ba med// 'dus byas chos la chos gsum tshang ba med// 'dus byas chos la tshang na 'dus byas min// 'bras bu'i rang bzhin yon tan skye mi 'gyur// 'bras bur grub phyir skye ba gang la srid// rang bzhin med na skye bar ga la 'gyur// de med pa las de ni skye ba med// ma skyes par ni skye ba gang yang med// skyes zin pa ni slar yang ji ltar skye// dngos de las ni dngos po de mi skye// de las tha dad pa ni gang la skye// dngos med las ni dngos po gang las skye// snga ma 'gags dang phyi ma ma skyes bas// da ltar gnas pa nyid ni ga la 'byung*// gnas tshar ba la gnas pa nyid ni mang*// ma gnas par ni gnas bar ga la 'gyur// 'gags zin phyir na slar yang 'gag pa med// ma 'gags par ni de bas 'gags pa med// ma skyes pa la 'gag pa med pa ste// gnas pa gnas pa'i phyir na 'gag pa med// skye ba skye ba'i phyir na 'gag pa med// chad dang rtag la 'gag pa yod ma yin// kun rdzob chos rnams rgyu dang rkyen las byung*/

/bden min rdzun min sgyu ma lta bu'i chos// snang tsam nyid nas ma grub rten 'brel yin// de ltar rtogs na spangs rtogs gang yang med// rgyu dang 'bras bu gcig dang tha dad min// cha shas bcas la rdzas gcig mi srid la// rdzas de'i rdzas su gcig pas tha dad min// bye brag so so'i rdzas rnams gcig pa min// bye (339)brag ji snyed yod pa dngos por gcig /dngos po dngos med gnyis kyang gcig pa min// gnyis ka shes bya yin phyir tha dad min// spyi yis ma khyab bye brag rdzas med la// bye brag rdzas ni spyi nyid ma yin no// chos nyid las gzhan chos can gcig kyang med// chos can sna tshogs chos nyid ma yin no// 'khor ba nyid las myang 'das tha dad min// mya ngan 'das pa 'khor ba nyid min no// shing dang lpags pa rnga yog lag pa sogs// kun las 'byung phyir sgra de tha dad min// sgra de shing sogs min pas gcig pa min// gang las ma skyes mi gnas 'gag pa med// 'dus byas thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma yin// nyi zla gang shar kun gyi shar yin phyir// shar nub lho byang gcig tu nges pa med// shar sogs phyogs la nges pa med pa'i phyir// mtha' med pas na dbus nyid ga la yod// thog mar skyes sam 'on te thog mar shi// gcig la gcig ltos thog ma ga la srid// zad pa med phyir 'khor ba'i mtha' ma gang*// thog mtha' med pas dbus nyid ga la rung*// dus mtha'i skad cig zhag dang zla ba lo// bskal pa'i thog mtha' ma dmigs dbus de bzhin// 'das dang ma 'ongs 'gags dang skye med phyir// bar du gnas pa'i skad cig ma de med// skye bzhin pa ni 'das dang ma 'ongs min// skye ba ma tshar bar du gnas pa'ang min// skye ba med la dus gsum ga la srid// 'gags zin na ni da lta gnas pa med// snga ma ma yin gzhan pa gnas med phyir// snga ma yin phyir da lta gnas pa med// da ltar ba yi skad cig ma 'di ni// snga ma la ltos phyi ma nyid yin la// phyi ma la bltos snga ma yin pas ste// snga phyi gnyis 'gal dus gsum (340)gcig pa 'gal// dus bzhi so sor snang tshul tha dad pa// byed pa po med 'dus ma byas su 'gyur// byed pa yod na mi dmigs su yis byas// rang sems 'khrul pa'i 'khrul snang sgyu ma bzhin// skyes nas da lta'i bar gyi bde sdug 'di// 'gags phyir med pas rmi lam sad pa bzhin// bag chags rgyun tsam min pa phyogs na med// lo zla zhag dang snga dro'i dus sogs mtshungs// bar do'i shes pa rigs drug skye gnas te// shar ba lus med pa yi blang bya'i yul// len po yin na blang yul med par 'gyur// skye gnas yid yul shar ba len pa po// yin phyir blang yul tha dad med pa'i phyir// blang yul yin na gong bzhin len po med// bag chags min pa skye gnas grub pa med// rnam shes dngos po med phyir lus sgyu yin// 'byung lnga'i rgyu las lus shig grub pa med// nur nur po nas lus po rdzogs pa'i bar// byed po med pas 'dus ma byas su 'gyur// rim pas 'gyur bas rtag pa med pas te// byas dang rtag pa med pas sgyu ma'i chos// dngos pos mthong na ro yis mthong thos 'gyur// sems kyis mthong na lo sogs med par 'gyur// med bzhin snang ba 'khrul pa'i mthong tshul ste// 'khrul pa dag nas 'khrul snang rang sar grol// yan lag lnga dang dbang lnga don snying lnga// snod drug lus min dbang po gcig tu 'gyur// lus po min na lus gzhan gcig tu 'gyur// de dag lhu dang sdum dang kham tshad dang*// rdul phran bar du cha shas phra mor gsil// 'dus ma byas sogs lus kyis bdag btsal lo// glu dang dbyangs dang yi ge sna tshogs rnams// ngag gi rgyun yin de dag re re las// ngag 'byung lhag ma gzhan gyis dgos pa med// bzhi ka dgos na rgyu ma 'bras zhig 'byung*// gre ba kha dang lce rkan so (341)mchu sna// re re'ang thams cad 'dus pa ga la skye// de dag snga ma bzhin du shes par bya// khong nas 'byung na yod pa'am med pa 'byung*// yod pa 'byung na gre sogs rkyen mi dgos// rkyen la ltos na yod pa ma yin no// med na khong nas 'byung ba ma grub po// gre sogs so so las ni 'byung ba na// thams cad dgos min ma tshang 'byung ba med// kha dog dbyibs sogs ma dmigs sgra de ru// ma skyes phyir na 'gag pa yongs med do// dpang po dbang yul rgyu la 'bras gnas la// rgyur mi rung ste 'bras bur grub zin phyir// 'bras dus ma gnas rigs gzhan rgyur mi rung*// rgyu med pa yis gzugs sogs 'bras bu med// gzugs sgra la sogs sems nyid snang ba na// yul dang yul du dus mnyam skye ba med// snga phyir skyes na shes pas yul mi 'dzin// 'das dang ma 'ongs med phyir yul ma skyes// ma skyes mi skye skyes zin skye ba med// gzugs sogs spyi don ma yin sems kyang min// tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed rnam shes rnams// spyir bstan snga ma bzhin du shes par bya// dmigs gsal kun gzhi shel dang tshon bzhin du// chos dbyings yul rkyen gcig dang tha dad min// dus gsum rgyu la gnas phyir skye mi dgos// rgyu la mi gnas gang las skye bar 'gyur// lus ni bem po yin phyir byed po med// las nyid ma grub phyir na 'bras ma skyes// grub na bden phyir 'bras bu gang la skyes// sems dang las gnyis gcig pa'am tha dad na// rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang ma grags dang*// bstod smad bde sdug 'jig rten chos brgyad po// rnyed sogs chags sdang 'phel phyir sdug bsngal rgyu// snga ma las 'dzad phyi ma bde par byed// blang dor med par sgyu mar ro mnyam mo// ngo tsha zhim dang mi zhim legs ma legs// skyid sdug (342)dgra gnyen phyogs gcig ma nges pas// ji ltar 'dzin pa de ltar 'char bas na// bden par ma grub sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can// ras bris me long gzugs brnyan ji lta bar// lha dang lha mo gang bsgom de dag gi

/dbu dang spyan dang phyag sogs rim gyis bsgom// phyi nang snod bcud gzhal yas khang pa dang*// lha dang lha mor mi brtan bar du bsgom// goms 'dris brtan pa dag pa'i sgyu lus yin// sems 'khrul bag chags bzhin du der snang ste// snang bzhin ma grub sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin// 'khrul pas snang la ma 'khrul mi snang bas// sems dang sems las gzhan pa ma yin no// sgyu lus gnyis la gom pa brtan pa las// sgyu ma gsum bsres 'khrul snang bden 'dzin 'jig /dag snang brtan pas cir snang lha ru 'char/ longs spyod rdzogs skur mngon par sangs rgya'o// sgyu lus dngos 'dzin rang grol gyi gdams pa rdzogs so/// /skye 'gag med pa 'od gsal ngang nyid las// sna tshogs rol pa sgyu ma'i skur shar nas// rmi lam lta bu'i 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// sgyu lus bsgoms pas bden 'dzin bden ma grub// gang snang spyod pa rmi lam nyid du blta// snang grags spyod lam nyin mtshan khyad par med// 'dun pa rtse gcig rmi lam nyid du sbyangs// nam phyed yol nas nyi ma ma dros bar// seng ge'i nyal thabs tsog bu skyil krung sogs// gang bder gnyid cing mdzod spu sogs gsum du// a la dmigs pas 'dun pa yang yang bskul// rten 'brel thabs kyis rmi lam sbar 'dzin bya// des ma zin na dmigs pa gzhan yang bsgom// bag chags che la nyin mtshan gnyis su bsgom// gang snang las sprul yi dam lha ru bsam// ya nga bag tsha thog rdzis 'dun pa bskyed// (343)rmi lam ngang nas phyag rgya che la bzhag /kun la nyin dang mtshan mo gnyis kar sbyang*// mos gus chung dang dam tshig thig le nyams// goms chung zhen che rnam g.yeng khyer ba rnams// rmi lam mi zin de las bzlogs par bya// 'khrul 'byams sad 'byams dran 'byams stong 'byams rnams// rmi lam gegs te 'dun pa drag po btang*// gnad kyi gdams pa shes pas skyon rnams bsal// rang bzhin rmi lam 'khrul pa'i rmi lam dang*// bag chags nyams dang dag pa'i rmi lam lnga// rmi lam rmi dang 'od gsal kha sgyur dang*// zin dang rgyun chad pa dang rnam pa bzhi// nyin snang mtshan snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags nyid// rang ngo shes dang 'od gsal shar ba las// bar do gnyis la mngon par sangs rgya'o// rmi lam nying 'khrul khregs gcod kyi gdams pa rdzogs so/// gang gi drin gyis bde chen ye shes ni// skad cig nyid la 'char bar byed pa yi// dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i rin po che// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// bum pa can la rab 'bring tha mar sbyang*// rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rang gnas lhag pa'i lha// gsal ba'i khong la stong pa'i dhū tir bsam// de steng bla ma nang du rang sems hūm̐// dhū ti'i rgyab tu chu skyes dmar po ste// gcig gis lhag pa'i bcu phrag gnyis brtsegs bsam// hika ka'i nga ros bde chen gnas su bskyal// ka hika ces pas gsang ba'i gnas su dbab// yang ni hūm̐ gi nga ros steng 'og bskyal// de la goms nas bla ma'i snying gar bstim// de nas 'og min gnas su 'phangs bya ste// slar yang dhū ti'i gnas su bzhag par bya// rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags gsum byung bar sbyang*// yang na nyi zla'i longs spyod 'gog pas so// 'byongs nas mgrin pa snying kha lte (344)ba dang*// gsang ba'i gnas su hūm̐ yig bsam par bya// gang du bgrod pa'i zhing der 'gro ba dang*// 'dun mos khyad par nyid du nan tan bya// lus dang rlung dang sems kyi 'gyur ba yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi ltas shes pa yis// 'chi slu bya zhing mi slus nges na 'pho// dus la bab na dag pa'i smon lam gyis// mtshams sbyar 'dun pa'i rta yis gang 'dod 'phangs// hūm̐ gi nga ros rten dang brten pa phral// dmigs pa rtse gcig gang 'dod gnas su 'gro// rnam par mi rtog phyag rgya che la bzhag

/rtags las 'chi ba'i nges pa ma thob bar// dus min 'phos na lha bsad ngan 'gror ltung*// dus la bab tshe 'pho bar byed pas na// mtshams med byas pa'ang thar pa'i gnas su 'gro// bshang sogs bu ga'i sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i lam// tshangs bug dag ni 'og min 'gro ba'i lam// lam 'di nas 'phos 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe// rnal 'byor pa ni nges par mkha' spyod 'gro// 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas kyi gdams pa rdzogs so/// /chos dbyings mkha' la mkhyen pa'i nyi ma shar// thugs rje'i rang rtsal gzugs sku'i tsha zer can// rmongs pa'i gdung sel gdul bya'i lo thog smin// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// sad pa'i dus der bar do'i dran pa brten// rtags rnams drug gis gang yin ngo yis bzung*// bskyed rdzogs gnyis la ma yengs mnyam par bzhag /gang 'jigs yul la mi phod thog brdzis bya// lha dang bla ma'i mos gus drag po brten// 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa de la ched du bsre// snang zhing ma grub stong par shes par bya// snod bcud thams cad lha dang lha mor bsgom// 'dod pa bsten pa yab yum zhal sbyor ro// nyi ma'i 'od sogs rnam byang 'od du lta// 'od de yid ma mi rtog ngang du bya// 'gro drug (345)skye gnas rigs mthun gang yang snang*// spong sems brtan cing lha sgom mi rtog pas// rlung dang char chu mi yi 'jigs pa dang*// me lce la sogs skrag sngangs skye ba'i yul// ched du bsam dang dngos su mthong ba na// thog brdzis bya zhing lha dang phyag rgya che// dag pa'i zhing du sems 'dun rgyun du 'phang*// longs spyod rlabs la snang mched thob pa gsum// sdud skyed rim pa bar do rnam pa gnyis// ngo shes bya zhing rgyun du nyams su blang*// g.yeng med gnas su mi rtog gnyug ma'i ngang*// yid dang mig ni nam mkha'i dbyings su gtad// du sogs rtags bcu ngo shes ngang du bzhag

/sa ni chur thim 'og lhung shes pa bying*// gos bsal du 'tshub lta bu'i mthong snang 'byung*// chu ni mer thim sna zhom lce nyid ni// so sgor mi thon mal tshig za zhing 'tshubs// smig rgyu lta bu'i mthong snang 'byung bar 'gyur// me nyid rlung thim dbugs rgod kha sna grang*// mi ngo mi shes srin bu me khyer mthong*// rlung nyid mkhar thim rtsa chu mi bsdams 'chor// mthong snang 'byung zhing mar me'i 'od 'dra mthong*// yan lag rlung lnga bsdus pas gzugs sgra dang*// dri ro reg bya mi tshor dbang shes thim// 'chi kha'i bsam pa las stobs che ba'i phyir// dug gsum kun slong phra nas bshags pa bya// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dam tshig sdom pa gso// lam gyi rnal 'byor yang yang gsal gdab bo// haṃ yig thur byon snang ba dkar lam 'char// a shad yar byon snang ba dmar lam 'char// dkar dmar rlung sems dbu mar dbang du 'dus// shes pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid la thim// dran med rgyal te snang ba nag thib 'gro// rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags pa las// shin tu spros med 'od gsal chen po 'char// dran 'dun rgyun chags (346)'od gsal ma bu mjal// 'chi kha chos sku'i zhing du sangs rgya'o// 'od gsal ma rtogs snga ma'i bag chags kyis// snga ma'i lus bzhin yid kyi lus su skye// rtags drug sgo nas bar do ngo shes bya// yid kyi lus de lha yi sku ru bsgom// ma bcos shes pa gnyug ma'i ngang du bskyang*// dran pa rtse gcig yang yang 'dun pa brten// shes pa 'khrul med goms 'dris brtan pa las// bar do longs sku'i zhing du sangs rgya'o// goms 'dris zhan pas bskyed rdzogs ma dran na// rang sems 'khrul pas sa chu me rlung gi /'jigs pa bzhi dang g.yang la lhung ba dang*// srin po gshin rje sha za khyi spyang sogs// 'khrul snang 'jigs pas shin tu sdug bsngal 'gyur// gces 'dzin dor la slar yang de la bsre// yul de lhar sgom gnas lugs ngang du bzhag

/phyed mtshams nas ni phyi ma'i snang ba 'char// dkar ser dmar dang sngo dang nag la sogs// 'od lnga'i lam las lha dang lha ma yin// dud 'gro yi dwags dmyal ba'i sems can gyi// srid par skye ba'i skye gnas 'dzin pa'i rtags// 'od lnga gang shar lha dang bla mar bsgom// 'od de'i steng du ma yengs so mar bzhag /gzhal med khang dang nags tshal nyams dga' dang*// ngang pa ba glang rta yis brgyan pa'i mtsho// mi nyid pho mo 'khrig pa bsten pa'i tshul// lha dang lha min sgra mi snyan pa dang*// ba glang spyod dang lus 'phags 'dzam gling du// skye ba len pa'i pha ma'i mthong tshul yin// sdong dum sbra mthong yi dwags skye ba ste// spyil po sa phug re rul dud 'gro'o// lcags kyi khang pa dmyal ba'i skye gnas te// kun kyang 'jigs pas skyabs tshol de ru 'gro// de dag mthong tshe 'jigs pas cher bros nas// chags sems med par mi rtog ngang du bzhag /dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang*// phyogs dang kha dog dbyibs kyi (347)rnam pa sogs// yid la bsams pas skad cig de la phyin// chos kyi 'phro mthud lam la goms byas nas// skye ba sprul sku'i zhing du sangs rgya'o// skye ba snga phyi'i bar gyi yid kyi lus// sngon gyi lus kyi rnam pa'i sha tshugs can// dbang po kun tshang gang la'ang ma thogs rgyu// bsams bzhin 'byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med// bar do nang nas lha yi mig gis mthong*// dri yi zas za ming gzhi'i phung po can// skye 'chi srid pa ting 'dzin bar do gsum// bar do tha mas snga ma gnyis po sbyor// skye 'chi bar dos ting 'dzin bar do sbyong*// ting 'dzin 'byongs nas mchog gi dngos grub thob// bar do sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gdams pa rdzogs so/// tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba nye ba'i lam// gol 'chugs med pa shin tu zab pa'i gnad// lam gyi nang nas mchog gyur rdo rje theg
/chos kun snying po rdo rje'i chos drug yin// zab lam rdo rje'i khrid khyad par 'phags pa'i chos drug rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bkod pa'o/// /(348)
